name: Alsórajk (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Alsórajk (a blue shield with a fleur-de-lis, a figure of a saint and a chief with a bough, an ox's head and a tree) above a yellow scroll inscribed ALSÓRAJK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
